questions.question: The use of what AWS feature or service allows companies to track and categorize spending on a detailed level?
questions.explanation: Cost allocation tags let companies track and categorize spending at a detailed level. Consolidated billing, Budgets, and Marketplace do not provide this categorization.

questions.question: Which service stores objects, provides real-time access to those objects, and offers versioning and lifecycle capabilities?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 stores objects with real-time access and supports versioning and lifecycle policies. Glacier is archival, Storage Gateway is hybrid, and EBS is block storage.

questions.question: What AWS team assists customers with accelerating cloud adoption through paid engagements in any of several specialty practice area ?
questions.explanation: AWS Professional Services accelerates cloud adoption through paid engagements across specialty practice areas. Enterprise Support, Solutions Architects, and Account Managers play different roles.

questions.question: A customer would like to design and build a new workload on AWS Cloud but does not have the AWS-related software technical expertise in-house. Which of the following AWS programs can a customer take advantage of to achieve that outcome?
questions.explanation: AWS Partner Network Consulting Partners provide the AWS technical expertise to design and build a workload when the customer lacks it in-house. Technology Partners offer software, Marketplace sells it, and Service Catalog governs products.

questions.question: Distributing workloads across multiple Availability Zones supports which cloud architecture design principle?
questions.explanation: Distributing workloads across multiple Availability Zones supports the 'design for failure' principle. It is not primarily about automation, agility, or elasticity.

questions.question: Which AWS services can host a Microsoft SQL Server database? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Microsoft SQL Server can run on Amazon EC2 (A) (self-managed) and Amazon RDS (B) (managed). Aurora and Redshift are different engines, and S3 is object storage. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which of the following inspects AWS environments to find opportunities that can save money for users and also improve system performance ?
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor inspects your environment for opportunities to save money and improve performance. Cost Explorer analyzes spend, and consolidated/detailed billing do not give recommendations.

questions.question: Which of the following Amazon EC2 pricing models allow customers to use existing server-bound software license ?
questions.explanation: EC2 Dedicated Hosts let you use existing server-bound (per-socket/per-core) software licenses (BYOL). Spot, Reserved, and On-Demand pricing models do not provide this host visibility.

questions.question: Which AWS characteristics make AWS cost effective for a workload with dynamic user demand? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS is cost-effective for dynamic demand because of elasticity (C) (scale with demand) and pay-as-you-go pricing (D) (pay for what you use). High availability, the shared security model, and reliability are benefits but not the cost drivers. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which service enables risk auditing by continuously monitoring and logging account activity, including user actions in the AWS Management Console and AWS SDKs?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail continuously logs account activity and API calls (console, CLI, SDKs) for risk auditing. CloudWatch monitors metrics, Config tracks configuration, and Health reports events.

questions.question: Which of the following are characteristics of Amazon S3? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is an object store (B) and a highly durable storage system (E). It is not a global/local/network file system. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which services can be used across hybrid AWS Cloud architectures? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 (A) and the Virtual Private Gateway (B) work across hybrid architectures (global DNS/routing and on-premises-to-VPC connectivity). A Classic Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, and default CloudWatch metrics operate within AWS. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: What costs are included when comparing AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) with on-premises TCO?
questions.explanation: A TCO comparison includes data center security costs (physical security) that AWS absorbs. Project management, antivirus licensing, and software development are not part of the infrastructure TCO comparison.

questions.question: A company is considering using AWS for a self-hosted database that requires a nightly shutdown for maintenance and cost-saving purposes. Which service should the company use?

options.text: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) with Amazon EC2 instance store
Amazon EC2 with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)

questions.explanation: For a self-hosted database needing nightly shutdowns, use Amazon EC2 with Amazon EBS, since EBS persists data across stop/start. Instance store loses data on stop, and Redshift/DynamoDB are managed services.

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct relationship between regions, Availability Zones, and edge locations?
questions.explanation: The correct relationship is that Regions contain Availability Zones. Edge locations are separate, and the other orderings are reversed.

questions.question: Which AWS tools assist with estimating costs? (Select three.)

options.text: AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Calculator

questions.explanation: Tools that assist with cost estimation include Cost allocation tags (B), the AWS Simple Monthly Calculator (C), and the TCO Calculator (D). A detailed billing report shows actual costs, and 'Cost Eliminator' is not a real tool. (Note: this question asks for THREE answers; the Simple Monthly Calculator and TCO Calculator are now part of the AWS Pricing Calculator.)

questions.question: Which of the following are advantages of AWS consolidated billing? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The ability to receive one bill for multiple accounts
Service limits increasing by default in all accounts
A fixed discount on the monthly bill
Potential volume discounts, as usage in all accounts is combined
The automatic extension of the master account's AWS support plan to all accounts

questions.explanation: Consolidated billing advantages include one bill for multiple accounts (A) and potential volume discounts from combined usage (D). It does not raise service limits, give a fixed discount, or extend the support plan. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which of the following Reserved Instance (RI) pricing models provides the highest average savings compared to On-Demand pricing?

options.text: One-year, No Upfront, Standard RI pricing
One-year, All Upfront, Convertible RI pricing
Three-year, All Upfront, Standard RI pricing
Three-year, No Upfront, Convertible RI pricing

questions.explanation: A three-year, All Upfront, Standard RI provides the highest average savings versus On-Demand. Longer term, full prepayment, and Standard (vs Convertible) all increase the discount.

questions.question: Compared with costs in traditional and virtualized data centers, AWS has:

options.text: greater variable costs and greater upfront costs.
fixed usage costs and lower upfront costs.
lower variable costs and greater upfront costs.
lower variable costs and lower upfront costs.

questions.explanation: Compared with traditional and virtualized data centers, AWS has lower variable costs and lower upfront costs (pay-as-you-go, no large capital outlay). The other options misstate the cost model.

questions.question: A characteristic of edge locations is that they:

options.text: host Amazon EC2 instances closer to users.
help lower latency and improve performance for users.
cache frequently changing data without reaching the origin server.

questions.explanation: Edge locations help lower latency and improve performance by serving cached content close to users. They do not host EC2 instances, cache constantly changing data without the origin, or refresh only daily.

questions.question: Which of the following can limit Amazon Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket access to specific users?

options.text: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies

questions.explanation: IAM policies limit S3 bucket access to specific users. Key pairs, Inspector, and security groups do not control per-user bucket access.

questions.question: Which of the following security-related actions are available at no cost?

options.text: Contacting AWS Professional Services to request a workshop
Attending AWS classes at a local university

questions.explanation: Accessing AWS forums, blogs, and whitepapers is free. Calling Support (beyond Basic), Professional Services workshops, and university classes generally have a cost.

questions.question: Which of the Reserved Instance (RI) pricing models can change the attributes of the RI as long as the exchange results in the creation of RIs of equal or greater value?
questions.explanation: Convertible Reserved Instances let you change RI attributes as long as the exchange results in RIs of equal or greater value. Standard RIs cannot change family/attributes the same way.

questions.question: Which AWS feature will reduce the customer's total cost of ownership (TCO)?
questions.explanation: Elastic computing reduces TCO by scaling capacity to actual demand instead of over-provisioning. The shared responsibility model, single tenancy, and encryption do not directly lower TCO.

questions.question: Which of the following services will automatically scale with an expected increase in web traffic?
questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing automatically scales its own capacity to handle increasing web traffic and distributes it across targets. CodePipeline, EBS, and Direct Connect do not auto-scale for web traffic.

questions.question: Where are AWS compliance documents, such as an SOC 1 report, located?
questions.explanation: AWS compliance documents such as SOC 1 reports are available in AWS Artifact. Inspector scans, CloudTrail logs, and Certificate Manager handles certificates.

questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following activities are the customer's responsibility? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Patching operating system components for Amazon Relational Database Server (Amazon RDS)
Maintaining environmental controls within a data center

questions.explanation: Customers are responsible for encrypting data client-side (B) and configuring Network ACLs (D). RDS OS patching, data-center staff training, and environmental controls are AWS responsibilities. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which is a recommended pattern for designing a highly available architecture on AWS?

options.text: Ensure that components have low-latency network connectivity.
Run enough Amazon EC2 instances to operate at peak load.
Ensure that the application is designed to accommodate failure of any single component.
Use a monolithic application that handles all operations.

questions.explanation: A recommended high-availability pattern is to design the application to accommodate the failure of any single component (no single point of failure). Low-latency-only focus, peak-load provisioning, and monolithic design do not ensure HA.

questions.question: According to best practices, how should an application be designed to run in the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: Applications should be designed with loosely coupled components so failures and changes in one do not cascade. Tight/'infrequent'/'frequent' coupling are not the best practice.

questions.question: AWS supports which of the following methods to add security to Identity and Access Management (IAM) users? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: You can add security to IAM users with Multi-Factor Authentication (D) and by enforcing password strength and expiration (E). Rekognition, Shield, and security groups are not IAM user security methods. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which AWS services should be used for read/write of constantly changing data? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: For constantly changing read/write data, Amazon RDS (B) (relational) and Amazon EFS (E) (file system) are appropriate. Glacier and Snowball are for archival/transfer, and Redshift is a read-heavy data warehouse. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: What is one of the advantages of the Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS)?

options.text: It simplifies relational database administration tasks.
It automatically scales databases for loads.
It enabled users to dynamically adjust CPU and RAM resources.

questions.explanation: A key advantage of Amazon RDS is that it simplifies relational database administration tasks (provisioning, patching, backups). The fabricated durability figure, automatic load scaling, and dynamic CPU/RAM tuning are not how RDS is described.

questions.question: A customer needs to run a MySQL database that easily scales. Which AWS service should they use?
questions.explanation: Amazon Aurora is a MySQL-compatible relational database that scales easily (Aurora Serverless can scale automatically). Redshift is analytics, DynamoDB is NoSQL, and ElastiCache is a cache.

questions.question: Which of the following components of the AWS Global Infrastructure consists of one or more discrete data centers interconnected through low latency links?
questions.explanation: An Availability Zone consists of one or more discrete data centers interconnected through low-latency links. Edge locations are for caching, and a Region is a group of AZs.

questions.question: Which of the following is a shared control between the customer and AWS?

options.text: Providing a key for Amazon S3 client-side encryption
Configuration of an Amazon EC2 instance
Environmental controls of physical AWS data centers

questions.explanation: Awareness and training is a shared control: AWS trains its employees while customers train their own. S3 client-side keys and EC2 configuration are customer-specific; environmental controls are inherited from AWS.

questions.question: How many Availability Zones should compute resources be provisioned across to achieve high availability?

options.text: A minimum of four or more

questions.explanation: High availability requires provisioning compute across a minimum of two Availability Zones, so the workload survives the loss of one AZ. One AZ has no redundancy.

questions.question: One of the advantages to moving infrastructure from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud is:

options.text: it allows the business to eliminate IT bills.
it allows the business to put a server in each customer's data center.
it allows the business to focus on business activities.
it allows the business to leave servers unpatched.

questions.explanation: An advantage of moving to the AWS Cloud is that the business can focus on its core business activities instead of managing infrastructure. AWS does not eliminate all IT bills, place servers in customers' data centers, or let you leave servers unpatched.

questions.question: What is the lowest-cost, durable storage option for retaining database backups for immediate retrieval?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is the lowest-cost durable option that still provides immediate retrieval for database backups. Glacier is cheaper but not immediate, EBS is pricier, and Instance Store is ephemeral.

questions.question: Which AWS IAM feature allows developers to access AWS services through the AWS CLI?
questions.explanation: IAM access keys let developers access AWS services through the AWS CLI (and SDKs/API). API keys, console passwords, and SSH keys are for other purposes.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fast and reliable NoSQL database service?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a fast, reliable, fully managed NoSQL database. Redshift is a data warehouse, RDS is relational, and S3 is object storage.

questions.question: What is an example of agility in the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Using Consolidated Billing to produce one bill
Decreased acquisition time for new compute resources

questions.explanation: Agility in AWS is shown by the decreased acquisition time for new compute resources (minutes instead of weeks). Instance variety, managed services, and consolidated billing illustrate other benefits.

questions.question: Which service should a customer use to consolidate and centrally manage multiple AWS accounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations lets a customer consolidate and centrally manage multiple AWS accounts. IAM manages identities, SCT converts schemas, and Config tracks configuration.

questions.question: What approach to transcoding a large number of individual video files adheres to AWS architecture principles?

options.text: Using a single large instance during off-peak hours
Using a large GPU instance type

questions.explanation: Transcoding many individual video files adheres to AWS principles by using many instances in parallel (horizontal scaling). A single large instance, dedicated hardware, or one big GPU instance does not parallelize as well.

questions.question: For which auditing process does AWS have sole responsibility?
questions.explanation: Physical security (of data centers) is an auditing/control area for which AWS has sole responsibility. IAM policies, S3 bucket policies, and CloudTrail logs are customer-managed.

questions.question: Which feature of the AWS Cloud will support an international company's requirement for low latency to all of its customers?
questions.explanation: AWS's global reach supports low latency for an international company's customers by serving them from nearby Regions and edge locations. Fault tolerance, pricing, and high availability address other needs.

questions.question: Which of the following is the customer's responsibility under the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: Patching Amazon EC2 instances (guest OS and applications) is the customer's responsibility. Patching the underlying infrastructure, physical security, and network infrastructure are AWS responsibilities.

questions.question: A customer is using multiple AWS accounts with separate billing. How can the customer take advantage of volume discounts with minimal impact to the AWS resources?

options.text: Create one global AWS account and move all AWS resources to that account.
Sign up for three years of Reserved Instance pricing up front.
Use the consolidated billing feature from AWS Organizations.
Sign up for the AWS Enterprise support plan to get volume discounts.

questions.explanation: Using consolidated billing through AWS Organizations lets the customer combine usage for volume discounts with minimal change to existing resources. Merging accounts, prepaying RIs, or buying Enterprise Support are not the right approach.

questions.question: Which of the following are features of Amazon CloudWatch Logs? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Summaries by Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)

questions.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch Logs offers real-time monitoring (D) and adjustable log retention (E). It is not free, does not provide SNS summaries, and does not include free Elasticsearch analytics. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)

questions.question: Which of the following is an AWS managed Domain Name System (DNS) web service?
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 is AWS's managed DNS web service. Neptune is a graph DB, SageMaker is ML, and Lightsail is simplified hosting.

questions.question: A customer is deploying a new application and needs to choose an AWS Region. Which of the following factors could influence the customer's decision? (Select TWO.)

options.text: The application's presentation in the local language
Proximity to the customer's office for on-site visits

questions.explanation: When choosing a Region, valid factors include reduced latency to users (A) and data sovereignty/compliance (C). Local-language presentation, climate-based cooling costs, and proximity for on-site visits are not Region-selection factors. (Note: this question asks for TWO answers.)
